newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Luxembourg ESM teams with Swiss co in satellite JV.
newsitem.headline: Luxembourg ESM teams with Swiss co in satellite JV.

text.p: Luxembourg-based European Satellite Multimedia Services (ESM) said in a statement on Wednesday that Switzerland's The Fantastic Corporation would cooperate in plans to launch a satellite-to-personal computer data service in autumn 1997.

"The partnership enables The Fantastic Corporation's media and content providers such as Reuters, SegaSoft, Ziff Davies and Conde Nast, to distribute their media in an innovative, fast and entertaining way on Astra-NET," ESM said in a statement.

ESM is the operator of Astra-NET, a unit of Luxembourg-based Societe Europeenne des Satellites (SES), which plans to use its Astra satellites to beam multimedia information into the back of PCs across Europe. Founded last December, ESM shareholders include SES, Deutsche Telekom, Intel Corp and Hughes Network Systems.
The Fantastic Corporation, based in Zug, Switzerland, was founded in February 1996 by commercial data broadcasting experts.
